oks: F-POUR pourless by declaration (assembly.yaml): ZERO copper zones BY DESIGN, and it is the safety argument rather than a layout convenience. The whole board is ONE floating keypad domain: BRIEF sections 4/5/7 and ADR-0009 forbid any ground, power or chassis bond on the keypad side of the OEM membrane interface, so there is no net to pour to — a pour tied to nothing is an antenna, and a pour tied to anything breaks the isolation the board exists to provide. MEASURED on the v1.1 board: the copper net set is EXACTLY the ten KP_U1..U6 / KP_D1..D4 nets and nothing else, 0 zones, both J_KEY_MATRIX MP tabs in no net, all 4 mounting holes np_thru_hole, both ZIF polarization bosses NPTH (verification/audit.txt).
